latest_messages.headline: Pre-market plan · holding steady · shutdown averted, watching oil + Wed inflation report
latest_messages.body: Ran the full research team pre-open — all 5 holdings passed their check-up (Cullen/Frost even got a small target bump from Morgan Stanley). Congress passed a funding bill so the Oct-1 shutdown risk is off the table, but oil jumped and interest rates are near multi-year highs — a headwind for pricey growth stocks and a reason I'm glad we're defensive. Sleeve is full (5/5), so no buys; keeping cash on the bench into Wednesday's core-PCE inflation report. No trades — market's closed.
